purpose: Compact navigation projection for ChatGPT. Exact legal handles remain authoritative in matching CURRENT AUTHORING_HANDLES.json. Technically eligible simple Sprite Animation clips may be selected directly by animationHandle without Actor-prefab ownership.
startHere: Search this compact index by intent first.
Use the exact handle returned here; open AUTHORING_HANDLES.json only for the full card.
Treat Actor handles as identity/presentation only. Do not use Actor animation repertoires as the primary animation-authoring surface.
For animation, select an exact directAnimationMaterials[].animationHandle from CURRENT. Direct animation materials are authoritative even when Actor ownership is unresolved.

Treat dialogue expressionIntent as opt-in, not a per-line default. Omit it for ordinary dialogue so the CharacterPack defaultExpression applies. Add it only for a deliberate visible acting beat, after resolving speaker to its cast identityHandle and requiring the token to be a literal member of that dialogueCharacters entry supportedExpressions; never auto-generate expressions from wording, mood or delivery, and never substitute Neutral.

When an intent has multiple animation candidates, open animationRetrievalPath and use its phase, sourcePath and preview evidence to choose deliberately; do not infer Start/Loop/End from a display name alone.
For every important visual choice, open previewUrl when present. If previewUrl is missing, treat appearance as unverified instead of guessing from the name.
Use atlasPage/atlasSlot only as secondary browsing evidence; previewUrl is the direct visual route.
Use cinematic recipes as directing guidance only; never serialize recipe IDs unless the active schema exposes such a field.
Author exactly one CUTSCENE_SCRIPT_V1 object; never invent raw Catalog/runtime IDs.
